pending_interview.category: System design — general (e.g. a URL shortener, a rate limiter, a notification system)
pending_interview.question: Design a real-time collaborative document editing system (think Google Docs) that supports concurrent edits from thousands of simultaneous users on the same document. Walk through your architecture end to end: how you handle conflict resolution between concurrent edits, how you propagate changes to all connected clients with low latency, how you persist state durably without losing edits, and where your main scalability bottlenecks are.
